title: Sixty-five
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The laundromat's shelf: sixty-five digests, one of each, the year done. The owner counts them with Wood. She says she's out of shelf. He says he'll bring a box. She says a box isn't a shelf. He says he'll bring a shelf. She says she'll hold him to it. She does, in March.

panels.composition: The laundromat. Under the counter: the stack. The LAUNDRY owner counting with a thumb. WOOD. BARNABY.

panels.composition: The stack. Sixty-five. The shelf full to the counter's underside.
